experiment: AWGN, independent uniform phase, frequency offset unknown to the network
notes: All signal windows have independent phase uniform on [0, 2*pi) and a random frequency offset from 0 to 1840 bins in steps of 80.
scan_cnn gets the window as received and searches every offset; correlator_magnitude gets it with the exact offset removed.
Training, validation, calibration and test random streams are disjoint.
Every receiver sees the same test IQ and is calibrated to the same Pfa target.
